# Documentation: a pull request that only changes these files (and those of
# no-ci.txt) is linted and tested on one platform, since the tests read the
# requirements, and is not packaged. A change to them alone makes no release.
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored. The files of the VS Code extension are never taken for
# documentation: they are in its package.
